operative_clauses.original_operative_text: SECTION 1. The transfer, provided by Section 5F of Reorganization Plan No. 1 of 1977 (42 FR 56101), of certain functions under the Federal Advisory Committee Act, as amended (5 U.S.C. App. 1), from the Office of Management and Budget and its Director to the Administrator of General Services is hereby effective.

original_source.page_or_item: American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); Sec. 1

operative_clauses.original_operative_text: SEC. 2. There is hereby delegated to the Administrator of General Services all the functions vested in the President by the Federal Advisory Committee Act, as amended, except that, the annual report to the Congress required by Section 6(c) of that Act shall be prepared by the Administrator for the President's consideration and transmittal to the Congress.

original_source.page_or_item: American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); Sec. 2

operative_clauses.original_operative_text: SEC. 3. The Director of the Office of Management and Budget shall take all actions necessary or appropriate to effectuate the transfer of functions provided in this Order, including the transfer of funds, personnel and positions, assets, liabilities, contracts, property, records, and other items related to the functions transferred.

original_source.page_or_item: American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); Sec. 3

operative_clauses.original_operative_text: SEC. 4. Executive Order No. 11769 of February 21, 1974 is hereby revoked.

original_source.page_or_item: American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); Sec. 4

operative_clauses.original_operative_text: SEC. 5. Any rules, regulations, orders, directives, circulars, or other actions taken pursuant to the functions transferred or reassigned as provided in this Order from the Office of Management and Budget to the Administrator of General Services, shall remain in effect as if issued by the Administrator until amended, modified, or revoked.

original_source.page_or_item: American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); Sec. 5

operative_clauses.original_operative_text: SEC. 6. This Order shall be effective November 20, 1977.

original_source.page_or_item: American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); Sec. 6
